items.title: 5.10 Energetics of phase changes (phase badalne mein energy) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.10, printed page 108.

blocks.text: Jab bhi matter mein koi physical change (jaise pighalna ya ubalna) hota hai, us ke saath hamesha energy change bhi hota hai. Yeh energy change batata hai ke intermolecular forces ki strength (taqat) mein kitna farq hai; yani yeh un forces ka quantitative (hisabi) measurement hai.

blocks.title: Molar heat of fusion
blocks.text: 1 atmosphere pressure par, melting point par, ek mole solid ko pighla kar liquid banane ke liye jitni heat absorb (jazb) hoti hai, use molar heat of fusion kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab barf (ice) ki molar heat of fusion 4.6 kJ mol⁻¹ chhapti hai. Sahi value taqreeban 6.01 kJ mol⁻¹ hai (0 °C par ek mole barf pighlane ke liye). Upar equation mein sahi value di gayi hai.

blocks.title: Molar heat of vaporization
blocks.text: 1 atmosphere pressure par, boiling point par, ek mole liquid ko ek mole vapour banane ke liye jitni heat absorb hoti hai, use molar heat of vaporization kehte hain.
Molar heat of vaporization intermolecular forces ki strength par depend karti hai. Jab 100 °C par ek mole H₂O vapour banta hai to 40.6 kJ mol⁻¹ heat absorb hoti hai.
NH₃ aur HCl ko apne boiling points par vapour banne ke liye sirf 21.7 aur 15.6 kJ mol⁻¹ chahiye. Yeh farq is liye hai ke pani mein intermolecular forces (hydrogen bonds) zyada mazboot hain.
Effect of Molar heat of vaporization and fusion on matter particles (particles par asar)

Molar heat of fusion aur vaporization matter ke particles ko kaafi energy de dete hain. Is energy se particles ek doosre se door hote hain aur matter ki state badalti hai: fusion se solid liquid banta hai aur vaporization se liquid gas. Liquid aur gas mein particles ko harkat karne aur ghoomne (rotate) ki zyada azadi mil jati hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Barf ki heat of fusion glaciers aur polar ice caps ke liye aham hai: barf pighalne ke liye bohat heat leti hai magar temperature 0 °C par hi rehta hai, is liye bari barf ki chadarein aahista aahista pighalti hain.

blocks.prompt: Pani ki molar heat of vaporization HCl se taqreeban teen guna kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Vapour banane ke liye molecules ko poori tarah alag karna parta hai, is liye zaroori heat intermolecular forces ka naap hai. Pani ke molecules do do hydrogen bonds se jure hain, jabke HCl mein sirf kamzor dipole-dipole aur London forces hain, is liye HCl ko kahin kam heat chahiye.

items: Molar heat of fusion: melting point par ek mole pighlane ki heat (barf 6.01 kJ mol⁻¹; kitab 4.6 chhapti hai). Molar heat of vaporization: boiling point par ek mole vapour banane ki heat (pani 40.6, NH₃ 21.7, HCl 15.6 kJ mol⁻¹).
Yeh heat particles ko door jane aur harkat ki azadi pane ki energy deti hai.
